# Factions & Organizations

## Abernethys {#abernethys}

The Abernethys are a family that resides at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters), a sprawling, isolated house situated at the edge of [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Agatha Sowerby Is Surprised P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Agatha Sowerby Is Surprised P3](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Agatha Sowerby Is Surprised P4](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Agatha Sowerby Is Surprised P5](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0005), +5 more_

## Aid Society {#aid-society}

The Church Aid Society is a church-affiliated organization in [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley) that counts Mrs. Agatha Sowerby as a primary pillar.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Agatha Sowerby Is Surprised P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER I. ## Aids {#aids}

The [Aid Society](../codex/factions.md#aid-society), or the Aids, is a community organization whose members gather for afternoon meetings and tea, with attendees including Mrs. Jasper Bell.

_Sources: [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P41](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0041), [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P42](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0042), [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P43](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0043), [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P44](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0044), +7 more_

## Americans {#americans}

Americans are summer visitors who consider the coast ideal and frequent the [Pale Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#pale-sands-hotel).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER V. Nell’s History P21](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER V. Nell’s History P22](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0022), [v1 CHAPTER V. ## Carrows {#carrows}

The Carrows are a family characterized by a strong streak of independence, exemplified by members such as John Carrow and his son Hugh.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXVII. The Reaper Whose Name Is Death P36](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0036), [v1 CHAPTER XXXVII. ## Conservative {#conservative}

The Conservative party is a political faction whose views are traditionally supported by the residents of [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) and by [Obed](../character/obed-abernethy.md), who considers adherence to the party a component of his faith.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Nell to the Rescue P5](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0005), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Nell to the Rescue P6](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0006), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Nell to the Rescue P7](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0007), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Nell to the Rescue P8](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0008), +18 more_

**Members:** [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Obed Abernethy](../character/obed-abernethy.md), [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md)

## Cottons {#cottons}

The Cottons are a family whose children include a trio of sickly-looking young girls who attend the [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley) school.

_Sources: [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P2](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0002), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P3](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0003), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P5](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0005), +5 more_

## Debating Club {#debating-club}

The Debating Club, also known as the [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley) Debating Club, is an organization that meets biweekly throughout the winter, hosts minor free entertainments, and organizes paid concerts featuring speeches, declamations, and choir performances to raise funds for its library.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P5](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0005), [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P6](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0006), [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P7](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0007), [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P8](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0008), +16 more_

## Grit {#grit}

The Grits are a political party whose members include certain school students, [Sukey](../character/sukey-pullen.md) Pullen's father, and potentially Mr. [Pidgeon](../character/pidgeon.md).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Nell to the Rescue P6](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0006), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Nell to the Rescue P7](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0007), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. **Members:** [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md)

## Improvers {#improvers}

The Improvers, also known as the B.V.I.S., are members of a thriving village improvement society who work to enhance the local area by planting grass and trees, adding floral arrangements, and petitioning to maintain community aesthetics.

_Sources: [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P29](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0029), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P30](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0030), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P31](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0031), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P32](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0032), +30 more_

**Members:** [Alexander Tranter](../character/alexander-tranter.md), Carrow, [Gideon Duckett](../character/gideon-duckett.md), [Honora Hollis](../character/honora-hollis.md), [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md), [Isolde Pembroke](../character/isolde-pembroke.md), [Julia Bell](../character/julia-bell.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Odette Pullen](../character/odette-pullen.md), [Oliver Mott](../character/oliver-mott.md), [Tibby Tulk](../character/tibby-tulk.md)

The Liberals are a political party whose members include [Agatha Sowerby](../character/agatha-sowerby.md), old Martin Bovyer, and Isolde's father.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Nell to the Rescue P37](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0037), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Nell to the Rescue P38](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0038), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. ## Presbyterian {#presbyterian}

The Presbyterian church is a religious denomination whose attendance is a longstanding family tradition and point of morality for the [Abernethys](../codex/factions.md#abernethys).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXV. Obed Insists on Puffed Sleeves P2](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER XXV. ## Tulks {#tulks}

The Tulks are a family from [Delford](../codex/places.md#delford)—including Roger and the taciturn painter Joshua—who drew the community's ire after painting a hall an unsightly bright blue due to a mix-up over the ordered color number.

_Sources: [v2 IX A Question of Color P23](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0023), [v2 IX A Question of Color P24](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0024), [v2 IX A Question of Color P25](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0025), [v2 IX A Question of Color P26](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0026), +18 more_

## Yankee {#yankee}

Yankees are individuals from the United States, against whom Mrs. Agatha harbors a specific bias due to her husband once being defrauded of ten dollars by a [Boston](../codex/places.md#boston) boss.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P43](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0043), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P44](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0044), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P46](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0046), +6 more_
